structure: Source is repos/trade-imports-ins-tests, scoped to tests/animals and tests/ins (page objects and test data under the repo's page-objects, domain and resources folders were read only where a spec leaned on them for a value). Layout: tests/animals/e2e/pages (one spec per journey page plus the dashboard, pagination and notification-view states), tests/animals/e2e/features (scope rules, documents, dashboard sort and search, delete, cancel-amend, amend-resubmit, hub groups, reference strip, auth, address-book handshake and copy behaviour), tests/animals/e2e/journeys (promoted journey, Dynamics, persistence), tests/animals/e2e/visual (one origin screenshot), tests/animals/a11y and tests/animals/security (Playwright a11y and security suites, listed but not mined claim by claim), tests/ins/e2e/features (address book add, edit, delete, persistence, auth, cross-user visibility, handshake guard; INS dashboard navigation; aggregated notification store; cross-service sessions), tests/ins/a11y (empty, .gitkeep only) and tests/ins/security/address-book. Many specs are tagged @duplicated-in-frontend (they mirror a frontend fit spec) and several are @compose or @mongodb only. Claims record what a spec proves a user can do or what rule it holds the suite to, with spec file and test or describe name as provenance. Left out: a11y and security specs beyond noting they exist, the plants project, page-object and fixture internals, and Playwright harness config. Notably absent from the scope: no spec mentions notification templates, and the INS dashboard has only one navigation spec in tests/ins.
